output.title: ACME profiles extension: issuer config not visible in environment
output.content: The release note says only that support for the ACME profiles extension was added (a feature). It does not say whether the feature is opt-in or changes existing behaviour. The environment shows cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate and the installed CRD certificates.cert-manager.io [v1]. The CRD dimension is absent, and no Issuer or ClusterIssuer manifests or ACME settings were supplied. Missing: whether any ACME Issuer or ClusterIssuer is used, and what the upstream notes say about default behaviour for existing issuers.
